texts: De'Von Achane tore his ACL Sunday vs KC and the Dolphins put him on IR Monday. His season is over. Ollie Gordon II is the Miami back to buy in PPR. Let's get to it. #PhinsUp

Ollie Gordon II was the only active back behind Achane Sunday. He handled 17 carries for 41 yards and a touchdown, plus 3 catches. Jaylen Wright sat with a stinger. Claim Gordon, 20 to 30 percent of FAAB. Stash Wright, 5 to 10 percent. #PhinsUp

The rest of Monday's injury notes are on the Pass. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
